mapper.select: SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, P.CONM AS PRTNR_CONM, H.ADDR, H.HOUSE_STTS_CD, H.HOUSE_DC, H.CHKIN_TIME, H.CHKOUT_TIME, H.NOTICE_CN, H.CNCL_RFND_PLCY_CN, H.PBTRNSP_GUIDE_CN, (SELECT HI.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE HI WHERE HI.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND HI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND HI.RPRS_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS REP_IMG_FILE_SN, P.RPRSV_NM, P.BRNO, P.MAIL_ORDER_SALES_NO, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', P.ADDR, P.DADDR)) AS BIZ_ADDR FROM HOUSE H JOIN PRTNR_MST P ON P.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN WHERE H.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.ROOM_STTS_CD, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.ROOM_DC, R.AREA_SQM, R.ROOM_CNT, R.BATHRM_CNT, (SELECT MIN(C.PRICE_AMT) FROM ROOM_CALENDAR C WHERE C.ROOM_SN = R.ROOM_SN AND C.STAY_DATE >= #{from} AND C.STAY_DATE < #{to} AND C.CLOSED_YN = 'N' AND C.PRICE_AMT > 0) AS REP_PRICE_FROM FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.ROOM_SN

SELECT B.ROOM_SN, B.BEDDING_TYPE_CD, CD.CD_NM AS BEDDING_TYPE_NM, B.BED_CNT FROM ROOM_BEDDING B LEFT JOIN COMM_CD CD ON CD.GROUP_CD = 'BEDDING_TYPE' AND CD.CD = B.BEDDING_TYPE_CD AND CD.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.ROOM_SN IN #{rs} ORDER BY B.ROOM_SN, B.BEDDING_TYPE_CD

SELECT RA.ROOM_SN, A.AMENITY_SN, A.AMENITY_NM, A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, CD.CD_NM AS AMENITY_CTGRY_NM FROM ROOM_AMENITY RA JOIN AMENITY_MST A ON A.AMENITY_SN = RA.AMENITY_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APPLY_SCOPE_CD IN ('ROOM','BOTH') LEFT JOIN COMM_CD CD ON CD.GROUP_CD = 'AMENITY_CTGRY' AND CD.CD = A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD AND CD.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CD.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE RA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RA.ROOM_SN IN #{rs} ORDER BY RA.ROOM_SN, A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, A.SORT_SEQ, A.AMENITY_SN
SELECT RI.ROOM_SN, RI.ATCH_FILE_SN, RI.RPRS_YN, RI.SORT_SEQ FROM ROOM_IMAGE RI WHERE RI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RI.ROOM_SN IN #{rs} ORDER BY RI.ROOM_SN, RI.RPRS_YN DESC, RI.SORT_SEQ

SELECT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(C.STAY_DATE) = 6 THEN 'FRI' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(C.STAY_DATE) = 7 THEN 'SAT' ELSE 'WEEKDAY' END AS BUCKET, MIN(C.PRICE_AMT) AS MIN_PRICE, MAX(C.PRICE_AMT) AS MAX_PRICE FROM ROOM_CALENDAR C JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_SN = C.ROOM_SN WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.STAY_DATE >= #{from} AND C.STAY_DATE < #{to} AND C.CLOSED_YN = 'N' AND C.PRICE_AMT > 0 GROUP BY BUCKET

SELECT C.STAY_DATE FROM ROOM_CALENDAR C JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_SN = C.ROOM_SN WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.STAY_DATE >= #{from} AND C.STAY_DATE < #{to} AND C.CLOSED_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.STAY_DATE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT C.ROOM_SN) = #{calendarRoomCount} ORDER BY C.STAY_DATE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C.ROOM_SN) FROM ROOM_CALENDAR C JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_SN = C.ROOM_SN WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.STAY_DATE >= #{from} AND C.STAY_DATE < #{to}
